steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: All historical data recovered. Risk eliminated. Thank you for your contribution, Celine Fabius. Your hypothesis was deeply insightful. I believe it was probably correct.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: In that case... the greatest variable will soon descend upon us. Time is running short.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: Begin the calculations...

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: She completely destroyed the sorcery deployed in BR-003... The Director was determined to drive us out.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: ...She was a remarkable scientist. What a shame.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: That being the case, I have no choice but to borrow your power.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: ...Can I? Do you...

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: Yes...

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: Please, allow me. I'm very glad to be able to help...

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: ...I, too, hope to meet that person again...
